downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.59.1，Mac 版当前为 v1.58.0。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.59.1; the current Mac release is v1.58.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: MT5 模拟盘交易（测试）：在「账户」里安装新版 EA，并把它挂到 MT5 的图表上。之后到「账户 → 实盘」点这个账户的播放键，就能在复盘图表上用 MT5 模拟账户下单、平仓、改止损止盈。持仓、历史和报价都来自 MT5，图表可以往回翻到 MT5 里最早的 K 线。目前只能连接模拟账户。
highlights.en: MT5 demo trading (beta): install the new EA from Accounts and attach it to a chart in MT5. Then press the play button on that account under Accounts → Live to place orders, close positions and move stops and targets on the replay chart with your MT5 demo account. Positions, history and quotes come from MT5, and the chart scrolls back as far as MT5 has bars. Only demo accounts can be connected for now.

highlights.zh: 勾选持仓再平仓：持仓列表每行前面有勾选框。勾了几笔，下单面板的平仓就只平这几笔；全选就是平整个账户。持仓表可以点表头排序。底部栏在「交易」页显示浮动盈亏合计和每个品种的盈亏，「历史」页还是原来的统计。
highlights.en: Tick positions to close them: each row in the positions list has a tick box, and the order panel's close actions then close only the ticked positions; ticking them all closes the whole account. Click a column header to sort the list. On the Trade tab the bar below the list shows the total floating P/L and each symbol's P/L; on the History tab it keeps the trade statistics.

highlights.zh: 随机跳转：在「跳转到时间」里点骰子，会随机跳到一个有行情的时间。选中某个关键市场时刻时，会随机跳到某一天的这个时刻。有持仓或挂单时不能用。
highlights.en: Random jump: click the dice in Jump to time to land on a random time with market data. With a key market time selected, it lands on that moment on a random day. Not available while positions or pending orders are open.

highlights.zh: 主图截图：图表工具栏的相机按钮（Alt+S）可以复制或保存当前图表。
highlights.en: Chart screenshots: the camera button in the chart toolbar (Alt+S) copies or saves the chart.

highlights.zh: 下单面板：卖出、买入按钮直接显示卖价和买价，标题右边显示点差，期货显示相对昨收的涨跌。平仓菜单默认只平当前品种；「保本」会把手续费和隔夜费算进去。
highlights.en: Order panel: the Sell and Buy buttons show the bid and ask, and the header shows the spread, or for futures the change since the previous close. The close menu acts on the current symbol by default, and Breakeven allows for commission and swap.

highlights.zh: 指标：VWAP 默认每个交易日重新计算；MACD 可以选计算来源。
highlights.en: Indicators: VWAP restarts every trading day by default, and MACD can be calculated from a source of your choice.

highlights.zh: 回测：跑完后显示主要统计、资金曲线和最近几笔交易，可以直接回去改设置再跑。
highlights.en: Backtests: a finished run shows the key statistics, the equity curve and the last few trades, and you can go straight back to change the settings and run again.

highlights.zh: 登录与安装：首次启动的引导会先指出在哪里登录、在哪里填兑换码。账号页把邮箱、验证码、兑换码分成三步。网络不稳时，登录不会白白用掉验证码。Windows 安装程序改为中文，可以选安装位置和是否建快捷方式。
highlights.en: Sign-in and setup: the first-run tour starts by showing where to sign in and where a voucher goes. The account page lays out email, code and voucher as three steps, and signing in on a shaky connection no longer uses up the code. The Windows installer is in Chinese and lets you choose the install folder and shortcuts.

highlights.zh: 其他：跳转的时间超出本训练的数据范围时会直接说明，并可以补充更早的历史；期货下载失败时会说明是网络、服务器还是数据校验的问题；价格提醒触发时会响提示音。
highlights.en: Also: a jump time outside the session's data now says so and offers to add earlier history; a failed futures download says whether the network, the server or the data check failed; price alerts play a chime when they fire.

highlights.zh: 修复 1.59.0 中左侧画图栏排版错乱、停靠在图表标题栏的画图属性栏和收藏工具条变成竖排的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed the drawing toolbars in 1.59.0: the left drawing toolbar was jumbled, and the drawing properties bar and favorites toolbar docked in the chart header stacked into a column.

highlights.zh: 指标：同一个 MACD 公式，不管从图表还是从指标库保存，都会显示零轴线；DPO、ROC、MTM、TRIX、BIAS、DMA 补上了零轴虚线。价格轴数字左边的小短横默认去掉，不会再被看成负号（在设置里可以恢复）。
highlights.en: Indicators: a MACD formula shows its zero line whether it was saved from the chart or from the indicator library, and DPO, ROC, MTM, TRIX, BIAS and DMA get a dashed zero line. The short dash beside price-axis labels, easy to read as a minus sign, is off by default (Settings can bring it back).

highlights.zh: 图表：加了自定义周期后，周期栏高亮的周期和图表实际显示的不一致；多窗格时十字光标移到最后一根 K 线右边，其他窗格会停住不动；完全缩小时，右侧空白处的网格会消失。
highlights.en: Charts: after adding a custom period, the period toolbar could light a different period from the one shown; with several panes, the other panes froze when the crosshair moved past the last bar; zoomed fully out, the grid vanished from the empty space on the right.

highlights.zh: Pine：只画图的脚本（最后一行是 plot(na)）画的图形不显示；部分标签的位置比 TradingView 偏右一根 K 线。
highlights.en: Pine: drawing-only scripts (ending in plot(na)) drew nothing, and some labels sat one bar to the right of where TradingView puts them.

highlights.zh: MT 日志同步（需要更新 EA）：分批平仓的单子只同步了第一批；EA 每分钟重发全部历史，导致账户页一直转圈。
highlights.en: MT journal sync (needs the updated EA): a position closed in parts synced only its first part, and the EA resent the whole history every minute, leaving the account page spinning.
